login.title: Sign in

forgot.subtitle: We'll send a link to set a new password. It works once and lasts an hour.

reset.title: New password

verify.title: Email confirmation

onboarding.note: Both can be changed later in settings. The base currency is only a way to show the total: account currencies and the rates recorded in transactions do not depend on it.
